sana: Quick convo: we need a concrete shape for how request/response capture interacts with routing & quotas. Legal wants guarantees about PII exposure in the console.

leo: Proposal summary: keep telemetry unchanged for normal traffic. Introduce a separate `capture_quota` per-tenant that gates any payload-level capture (responses, attachments, embeddings). Metadata always allowed.

aria: UX: console should show three indicators: quota remaining (%), last approver (name+id), and capture mode (metadata-only / truncated / full). Red state when <15%. Provide a one-click request to owner that creates an approval ticket.

sre-max: Technical notes: `capture_quota` is weight-based: low=1, med=5, high=20. Route config declares sensitivity and default weight. On approval we mint an `approval_token` that is attached to captured events. All captured items store only `fingerprint=hmac:v1:<hash>` and `pseudo_id` (no raw ids).

legal-bot: Reminder: embeddings & files are high-sensitivity by default. Any request to capture them requires explicit approval and an entry in the immutable audit ledger.

leo: For HMAC: per-tenant salt + versioning. Salt rotation policy: rotate quarterly, do not backfill historical items (only new captures re-hash). Store salt_id with envelope.

aria: Console copy: do not display raw payload unless capture mode == full AND approver + legal_hold present. Show TTL and deletion link.

sre-max: Edgecases: replay/playback of past captures should count against the same quota and require the approval_token. Emergency override allowed but must: 1) create immutable audit entry, 2) flag event as `emergency=true`, 3) consume quota at high weight. Also auto-notify compliance channel.

leo: Envelope sketch (metadata-first): `env:v4, tenant:t-*, sample_reason:capture:manual, fingerprint:hmac-v1:..., sensitivity:high, summary:"truncated"` (all as strings).

aria: Retention defaults: captured payloads TTL=21d, metadata TTL=90d. Provide legal_hold API that prevents deletion and requires justification.

sre-max: Runbook: thresholds at 25% (notice), 10% (escalate owner), 0% (auto-fallback to metadata-only). Add observable `capture_quota_burn_rate` and per-tenant dashboard tile.

legal-bot: Compliance: require RFC before beta rollout, include test plan for 2 tenants and a rollback.

sana: Action items: leo -> RFC for HMAC + envelope; aria -> console mockups + copy; sre-max -> quota accounting + alerts; loop in compliance/security. Aim to ship behind `feature:tenant_capture_v1` and enable for 2 tenants in the canary.

leo: I'll post the RFC link in this thread when ready.

sre-max: +1. Also adding a note: devs should never see raw identifiers in console; exports require SRE-mediated flow.

sana: Thanks all. short RFC please, cc legal/security.

leo: RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/r/tenant-capture-v1
